messages.author: 1354f0aaefd7d429
messages.subject: Inverse Theme for Dark Backgrounds?
parts:
I'm about to create PDFs with plots that I'll put on slides with a
dark background. If someone has already created a theme for this I'd
be grateful for sharing it.

More specifically, I am going to use the dark gradient background
theme in Apple's Keynote presentation software. I would expect that in
general white lines and text will look good as well as semi-
transparent areas. I am aware of ggplotpp package that defines some
themes and would start with these for defining my own.

-- Christian
